newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU proposes 250 mln Ecus untied aid for Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: EU proposes 250 mln Ecus untied aid for Bulgaria.

text.p: The European Commision said on Wednesday it would propose up to 250 million Ecus of untied balance of payments support for Bulgaria.
The Commission announced it would propose the new aid in a joint statement of a meeting of the Group of 24, the world's richest 24 countries, which the EU executive had organised with the World Bank.

The statement said that Bulgaria's caretaker government "has shown strong commitment to implement a bold macro economic stabilisation and structural reform despite exceptionally difficult circumstances".
But the meeting urged Bulgaria to keep its economic programme on track and implement it within the agreed time frame.
The Commission also said it would propose an additional targetted social and structural reform assistance up to 40 million Ecus under the EU's phare programme.
